These places are a cornerstone of the spiritual journeys of many people and are marked by a profound sense of reverence and dedication to the pursuit of enlightenment.
data.spiritual_significance: Ashram signifies a strong connection to spirituality and the quest for inner peace, self-realization, and divine knowledge.
